The WorkOS twin's GET /user_management/users/{id}/sessions returns sample sessions under `items` (not the API's `data`), and POST /user_management/sessions/revoke echoes any id, so revocation can't be observed. The runtime lists and revokes real sessions; covered by local tests.
The verifier can't place a provider write between the runtime's directory read and its removal inside one run. The write-time re-check is covered by a deterministic local test.
